A given remote's ls-remote call returns None (unreachable) -> out['not_evaluable']=f'the remote {remote} could not be listed', return immediately (fails closed on the first unreachable remote)
tracking = local ref table lookup for refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch-name-with-refs/heads/-prefix-stripped>
tracking is not None (we do have a local tracking ref for this branch) AND tracking != the remote's current sha -> this ref moved; record as 'name' (origin) or 'remote:name' (other remotes)
(nested) the remote's current sha is not among local_shas -> this moved ref did not land on any local ref (push didn't land, or a foreign move)
out['remote_ref_moved'] = moved
out['remote_landed'] = not unlanded (landed iff nothing was left unlanded)
